title: Yummy Chinese Oyster Mushrooms Stir-fry
description: A romantic, umami-packed oyster mushroom dish with a mapo-tofu vibe, pressure‑cooked to tender perfection.
instructions: Dice the oyster mushrooms into bite-sized pieces.
In the pressure cooker, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add the diced mushrooms and stir until they start to brown, about 2 minutes.
Add minced garlic, grated ginger, and ground Sichuan peppercorns, cooking for another minute until fragrant.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of black bean paste and 15ml of kosher soy sauce, coating the mushrooms evenly.
Pour in 240ml of vegetable stock, seal the pressure cooker, and cook on high pressure for 5 minutes.
Quick release the pressure, then stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of peanut oil for extra sheen and flavor.
Plate the stir-fry and garnish with sliced scallions or chopped cilantro if desired.
